name: P I Industries Ltd
about: PI Industries Ltd is a leading player in the agro-chemicals space having strong presence in both Domestic and Export markets. It has state-of-art facilities in Gujarat having integrated process development teams with in-house engineering capabilities. [1]

flags.text: Debtor days rose from 43 to 88 in three years: customers are taking longer to pay

business.what: PI Industries makes agrochemicals and related chemistries. It earns revenue by exporting custom-synthesis and agchem chemistries to global innovators, selling domestic crop-protection brands through distributors and retailers, and growing pharma, electronic chemicals and biologicals businesses.

segments.name: Agchem export business (CSM)
segments.comment: Soft demand and pricing pressure; near-term challenges, recovery expected second half.

segments.name: Domestic agri business (crop protection brands)
segments.comment: Volume up 12% but revenue up only 3%; monsoon improving, new launches planned.

segments.name: Biologicals
segments.comment: Grew about 50%, three-year CAGR of 15%; global expansion ongoing.

segments.name: Pharma (CRO/CRDMO)
segments.comment: Early positive signs; transition to CRDMO is long-term, no quarter figures given.

segments.name: Electronic and specialty chemicals
segments.comment: New queries and commercialization continuing on track; no figures given.

ledger.promise: FY26 EBITDA margin in line with annual guidance (25%-26% per Q3 call; analyst on Q2 call cited 26%-27%)
ledger.quote: So, we will keep to our guidance as earlier.
ledger.actual: FY26 EBITDA 1,732 on revenue 6,714 = 25.8%. That is inside the 25-26% stated on the Q3 call but below the 26-27% the analyst cited on the Q2 call.

ledger.promise: Domestic and AgChem export recovery in Q4 FY26 to offset the H1 decline
ledger.quote: We also anticipate a recovery in our domestic and agchem exports, particularly in Q4, to offset the decline in revenue and profitability in the first half.

ledger.promise: Sequential revenue improvement starting Q4 FY26
ledger.actual: Revenue went from 1,376 in Q3 FY26 to 1,565 in Q4 FY26 (+13.7%), then 1,702 in Q1 FY27 (+8.8%), and stayed at 1,702 in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: CSM/AgChem export recovery from Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: As we have already guided that we anticipate recovery from Q4FY26 and accordingly, this whole year will pan out.
ledger.actual: On the same call the date moved to H2 CY2026 (p17). The Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 calls now point to export recovery in H2 FY27.

ledger.promise: FY27 revenue growth, later put at lower single digits
ledger.quote: we are positive to say that we will start seeing growth in FY27.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue 3,404 vs 3,772 (-9.8%). To beat FY26's 6,714, H2 needs more than 3,310, which is +12.5% on H2 FY26's 2,941.

ledger.promise: Effective tax rate of 22%-23% for the next 2-3 years
ledger.quote: We expect the ETR to be in the range of 22%-23% for the next 2-3 years.
ledger.actual: Six months later (Q4 FY26 call) it was raised to 24% for FY27 onward. Tax implied by H1 FY27 PBT 506 and PAT 366 is about 27.7%.

ledger.quote: broadly, it will be about INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore.
ledger.actual: Raised to 700-800 crore on the Q4 FY26 call and repeated on the Q1 FY27 call. FY26 investing outflow was 612; FY27 CWIP is 999.

ledger.promise: Improve trade working capital from 113 days as markets normalise
ledger.quote: We expect to improve this as the market scenario normalises in the coming quarters.
ledger.actual: Rose to 139 days by the Q3 FY26 call. FY26 cash conversion cycle was 119 days vs 42 in FY25 (debtors 88, inventory 157). Operating cash flow 474 vs 1,413.

ledger.promise: Pharma to reach scale and positive EBITDA within about one year
ledger.quote: we expect that in next 1 year, we will reach to a scale that will be able to sustain and maintain profitable growth and also achieve positive EBITDA.
ledger.actual: Six months later (Q4 FY26 call) this became positive EBITDA at 500-600 crore of revenue in the next two to three years. On the Q1 FY27 call, subsidiary losses are expected for a few more quarters.

ledger.promise: Indian biologicals regulatory disruption sorted in Q3-Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: We are expecting to see in this coming quarter or the next quarter for that to wind down and get sorted.
ledger.actual: The Q3 and Q4 FY26 calls both cite delays in the biologicals regulatory transition. On the Q1 FY27 call, the India launch is 'hoping within the year', depending on the regulatory framework.

ledger.quote: We remain on track to commercialise 8 to 10 new molecules in the current fiscal, having commercialized 5 in H1.
ledger.actual: The Q3 FY26 call still said 5 commercialised. No later call gives the final FY26 count.

ledger.promise: Sustainable gross margin of 50%-52%; hold FY26 average gross margin in FY27
ledger.quote: 50% to 52% gross margin is what we believe is a sustainable level.
ledger.actual: No gross margin data in the materials. EBITDA margin fell to 13.7% in Q2 FY27, and the Q1 FY27 call cited high input costs.

current_guidance.target: Lower single-digit growth over FY26, led by export recovery in H2 and new launches
current_guidance.quote: we are looking at a positive trajectory, and in the lower single digit as indicated earlier
We expect ETR for FY27 to be around 24%.
We have given a guidance of Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crore, which is the standard capex

current_guidance.target: Hold targeted gross margins through product-mix optimisation (no number given)
current_guidance.quote: we will try and maintain with the optimization that the company is trying to do to manage and look at maintaining the targeted gross margins

current_guidance.target: Launch within FY27, depending on the regulatory framework
current_guidance.quote: We are hoping within the year we should get the launch for India.

current_guidance.target: One geography next year, one the year after
current_guidance.quote: one coming up for one geography next year, and one for the year after

current_guidance.target: A couple of electronic chemicals products, one or two pharma products, plus AgChem launches
current_guidance.quote: Broadly, in the Agchem area this year, the Electronic chemicals too, would be about a couple of products and one or two in the Pharma

credibility.label: low
credibility.summary: Management delivered the FY26 EBITDA margin band (25.8% against 25-26%) and the sequential revenue pickup it promised from Q4 FY26. Most other dated promises slipped. The Q4 FY26 recovery missed, the CSM recovery moved twice (Q4 FY26, then H2 CY2026, then H2 FY27), the pharma EBITDA-positive target went from one year to two-to-three years, the tax rate went from 22-23% to 24%, working capital got worse instead of better, and H1 FY27 revenue is down 9.8% against a full-year growth guide.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q1 FY27 call: the company is 'steadily transitioning towards a growth trajectory' after a soft quarter.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 revenue was 1,702, down 9.1% from 1,872. EBITDA fell 56.9% to 233 (margin 13.7% vs 28.9%), and PAT fell 70.2% to 122 from 409.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q2 FY26 call: trade working capital is high because of market conditions and should improve as markets normalise.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Instead it rose to 139 days (Q3 FY26 call). The FY26 cash conversion cycle was 119 days vs 42 in FY25, and operating cash flow fell to 474 from 1,413 (2,036 in FY24).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q2 FY26 call: the strong quarterly margin came from product mix.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: The 28.9% margin in Q2 FY26 did not hold. It was 21.9% in Q3 FY26, 21.5% in Q4 FY26, 21.6% in Q1 FY27 and 13.7% in Q2 FY27. TTM margin is 19.5% (1,239/6,345).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q3 FY26 call: aggressive investment in new businesses may cause 'EBITDA challenges'.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin has stayed at or below 21.9% for four quarters and fell to 13.7% in Q2 FY27. The Q1 FY27 call blames front-loaded subsidiary spending, so the warning matched what followed.

bull.point: Revenue has come back from its trough, as management said it would
bull.evidence: Quarterly revenue rose from 1,376 in Q3 FY26 to 1,565 in Q4 FY26 and to 1,702 in both Q1 and Q2 FY27, a 23.7% gain from the low.

bull.point: FY26 margin guidance was met even though revenue fell
bull.evidence: FY26 EBITDA margin was 25.8%, inside the 25-26% band, while revenue fell 15.8% to 6,714.
bull.source: Q3 FY26 call p7; reported numbers

bull.point: The balance sheet can absorb the investment phase, and capacity is already under construction
bull.evidence: Borrowings are 300 crore against TTM EBITDA of 1,239. Capital WIP is 999 crore, and the 700-800 crore capex guide covers manufacturing, launches and R&D.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q1 FY27 call p11

bear.evidence: Q2 FY27 EBITDA was 233 (13.7% margin) and PAT was 122, down 56.9% and 70.2% from a year earlier. TTM PAT is 878 vs 1,660 in FY25.

bear.point: Recovery and break-even dates keep moving
bear.evidence: CSM recovery moved from Q4 FY26 to H2 CY2026 to H2 FY27. Pharma positive EBITDA moved from 'next 1 year' to two-to-three years at 500-600 crore of revenue.
bear.source: Q2 FY26 call p12, p17; Q4 FY26 call p5, p11

bear.point: Cash generation is weak while spending rises
bear.evidence: Operating cash flow fell to 474 in FY26 from 2,036 in FY24, and the cash conversion cycle rose to 119 days. FY27 capex was raised to 700-800 crore, and management expects heavy market-building spend and subsidiary losses.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q4 FY26 call p12; Q1 FY27 call p15
